script_text: Aquarius, the cosmos ignites your Air element this week as Uranus forms a sudden trine to your ruling planet. Monday brings a harsh Saturn square to your 10th House career sector, demanding extreme patience with your critical professional money matters. By Wednesday, Mercury sextiles your natal Uranus, restoring vital mental clarity to all your workplace communication. The critical shift occurs Thursday when Venus enters your 5th House of romance, creating a joyful sextile to your natal Mars. This love aspect sparks an unexpected connection. The weekend transforms your 7th House of partnerships as the Sun trines Jupiter, opening a loving open door to a significant other. Tuesday is your worst day because Saturn squares your career. Friday is your best day because Venus enters your 5th House. Focus solely on your future goals this week to properly harness this powerful cosmic momentum. Follow for daily updates.
